name: Prisoners without an emergency contact or next of kin
description: Prisoners currently in custody at the selected prison with no active, unexpired emergency contact or next of kin recorded in personal relationships

dataset.name: Prisoners without an active emergency contact
dataset.query: SELECT ob.agy_loc_id AS prison_code, est.name AS prison_name, o.offender_id_display AS prisoner_number, INITCAP(o.last_name) || ', ' || INITCAP(o.first_name) AS prisoner_name, COALESCE(c.total_contacts, 0) AS total_contacts, COALESCE(c.lapsed_key_contacts, 0) AS expired_or_inactive_key_contacts, 'Manage contacts' AS contacts_link FROM prisons.nomis_offender_bookings ob JOIN prisons.nomis_offenders o ON o.offender_id = ob.offender_id LEFT JOIN datamart.establishment_establishment est ON est.id = ob.agy_loc_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT prisoner_number, SUM(CASE WHEN active THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_contacts, SUM(CASE WHEN (emergency_contact OR next_of_kin) AND NOT (active AND (expiry_date IS NULL OR expiry_date >= CURRENT_DATE)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lapsed_key_contacts, MAX(CASE WHEN (emergency_contact OR next_of_kin) AND (active AND (expiry_date IS NULL OR expiry_date >= CURRENT_DATE)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_valid_key_contact FROM prisons.personalrelationships_prisoner_contact GROUP BY prisoner_number) c ON c.prisoner_number = o.offender_id_display WHERE ob.active_flag = 'Y' AND ob.in_out_status = 'IN' AND COALESCE(c.has_valid_key_contact, 0) = 0

field.name: expired_or_inactive_key_contacts
field.display: Expired or Inactive Emergency Contact / Next of Kin

dataset.name: Prison Name Filter
dataset.query: SELECT DISTINCT est.name AS prison_name FROM prisons.nomis_offender_bookings ob JOIN datamart.establishment_establishment est ON est.id = ob.agy_loc_id WHERE ob.active_flag = 'Y' AND ob.in_out_status = 'IN'
